ui.title: Failed Provisioning Remediator
ui.tagline: Picks up a failed provisioning job, finds the root cause from logs and live state, and fixes it - automatically when the fix is on your safe list and low risk, otherwise after an operator approves, with on-call paged if nobody answers.

actions.label: Run: Failed provisioning remediation
actions.description: A provisioning job fails. Kaman classifies the failure, diagnoses it from the job logs and the resource's live state, plans a remediation and runs it automatically only if it is on the safe list and low risk; anything else waits for an operator, and an unanswered request pages on-call.

inputs.label: Request
inputs.default: Linux VM, 8 vCPU / 32 GB, app tier, cluster C2

inputs.name: error
inputs.label: Error
inputs.default: Timeout waiting for IP address from DHCP after 600s

actions.label: Ask the Provisioning Diagnostician
actions.description: Finds why a provisioning job failed from AWS's logs, EC2 state and Health events.
